summary.text: The six headed snake is a desolate beast whose strength matches rank six Gu Immortals. Its black blood feeds Calamity Beckoning Gu, and every part of its body is useful for Gu refinement.

claims.text: Calamity Beckoning Immortal Gu’s food is the black blood of the desolate beast six headed snake. Fang Yuan lists six headed snake and cloud dragon among desolate beasts that are hard to come by and have strength equivalent to Gu Immortals, alongside the ancient desolate beast worldly sand gull.

Little Hu Immortal land spirit reports that a Gu Immortal is selling parts of a dead six headed snake in treasure yellow heaven. Calamity Beckoning Gu feeds on that desolate beast’s black blood. The seller says the snake had been dead for close to a hundred years, so the black blood had already seeped out. Fang Yuan checks the corpse, confirms the claim, and still buys the bones. The six headed snake is a desolate beast with strength comparable to rank six Gu Immortals. Its whole body is a treasure, and every part can be used in Gu refinement. He sets a Gu formation that continually consumes the skeleton in a blood pool to create black blood.

Fang Yuan has already fed Calamity Beckoning Gu with six headed snake black blood. The six headed snake is a desolate beast with six heads. Having once bought a corpse in treasure yellow heaven, he plans to move several six headed snakes into his immortal aperture to breed them for the long term.
